title: Manitowoc expands Australian support network with new Queensland and Victoria facilities
summary: New factory-direct facilities in Yatala and Melbourne strengthen Manitowoc’s service, parts, and technical support capabilities across Australia’s East Coast.Expanded local resources will provide customers with faster access to factory-trained technicians, parts, and components.
body_markdown:
- New factory-direct facilities in Yatala and Melbourne strengthen Manitowoc’s service, parts, and technical support capabilities across Australia’s East Coast.
- Expanded local resources will provide customers with faster access to factory-trained technicians, parts, and components.


Manitowoc is expanding its customer support operations in Australia with new facilities in the states of Queensland and Victoria. The new locations expand the Company’s service capabilities across Australia’s east coast, as demand for Grove mobile cranes and Potain tower cranes continues to grow, driven by infrastructure, renewable energy and urban development projects. The investment reinforces Manitowoc’s commitment to enhancing aftersales services, parts distribution and customers’ access to technical expertise in Australia.


Located in Yatala (Queensland) and Melbourne (Victoria), the new facilities provide additional workshop space, field service, and sales support, complementing Manitowoc’s established operations in Sydney (New South Wales), where the Company has recently moved to a much larger facility. The new branches will provide faster access to factory-trained technician support and parts delivery to an expanding crane population.


## Expanding in Queensland


Located in the industrial corridor between Brisbane and the Gold Coast, Manitowoc’s new Yatala facility provides a strategic base for supporting customers across the state, where major infrastructure development is expected to continue ahead of the Brisbane 2032 Olympic and Paralympic Games.


The facility includes four workshop bays, a dedicated wash bay, an outdoor covered work area, and more than 2,200 m² of hardstand space. The additional capacity gives Manitowoc room to expand its local service and support operations as the fleets of Grove and Potain cranes in Queensland grow.


## Building a permanent base in Victoria


In Victoria, Manitowoc has opened a dedicated three-bay facility in Melbourne’s western industrial area. The new site provides a permanent base for a growing local team supporting both Grove and Potain crane customers throughout the state.


The facility has approximately 1,400 m² of outdoor space and is currently staffed by mobile and tower crane technicians, sales specialists, and a spare parts manager. The Victoria team will also be supported by dedicated crane experts serving customers in Tasmania.
